messages:
Priya Nair: Heads up teams — quick Q3 budget guidance + vendor onboarding reminder. Please skim and act this week.
Joel Rivera: Quick Q: deadline for updates?
Priya Nair: End of day Friday (5pm PT). Put headcount changes and any new committed spend in the Q3 sheet.
Anya Sokol: Any change to the PO thresholds?
Priya Nair: Yes: effective now, any vendor with projected annual spend > $5,000 requires a PO and vendor risk review. Renewals that cross the threshold also need re-approval.
Joel Rivera: Card purchases still allowed under $500?
Priya Nair: Correct. Corp card ok for <$500. Purchases $500	$5k require manager approval + PO request. >$5k requires full onboarding.
Anya Sokol: If we're onboarding a vendor but need them fast (e.g., infra outage), what's the emergency path?
Priya Nair: Emergency route: 2 manager approvals + an explicit finance email sign-off. Log it in #procurement-emergencies and cc finance@redwood.com; we'll issue a retro PO.
Priya Nair: Teams should start the vendor questionnaire (link in Confluence) and attach quotes/SOWs. Procurement will follow up on security and risk.
FinanceBot: Reminder scheduled: "Q3 budget submissions" will ping finance + ops tomorrow at 10:00.
Joel Rivera: We'll push a prioritized renewals list from Platform by Wednesday.
Anya Sokol: Thanks 44d — will update our requests.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. DM me or reply here for clarifications.
